I found one 2025 prediction from Jensen Huang that meets all four tests, and I could only read it in news coverage, not in his own words. A second, clearer prediction from his December 2025 Joe Rogan interview is a strong lead, but I couldn't open a page that carries it, so it isn't listed.

**The one candidate: humanoid robots, GTC, March 2025.** Reuters, as printed by Yahoo Finance, says Huang believes humanoid robots are less than five years away from seeing wide use in manufacturing facilities. That sentence is the reporter's summary, and the Yahoo page I opened showed nothing beyond it. Tech.co does print his words, but they contradict themselves: "When, literally, humanoid robots are wandering round, which is not five years away. This is five-years-away problem, this is a few-years-away problem." In search snippets (not pages I opened), other outlets print the second sentence as "This is not five-years-away problem", so tech.co's version is probably a transcription slip. Please check it against a recording. It doesn't match any of the three recorded claims.

**Not listed:**
- **Rogan lead (December 3, 2025):** Several search snippets carry a line about AI generating "90% of the world's knowledge" in "maybe two or three years". The one transcript page I opened was cut off before that point. The podscripts page wouldn't open ("url_not_allowed"), and that failed attempt used my last opening.
- **"More millionaires in five years" (All-In podcast, July 2025):** I only saw this in search snippets. It's also arguably a forecast about wealth rather than about what AI will do.
- **Stratechery interview (May 19, 2025):** His "a couple years from now" about robotics is undated and not about AGI. His "next five, ten years" line is about GDP and a new industry, which is economics rather than AI.
- **Bg2 podcast (September 2025):** The dated lines there are about revenue and data-centre spending, which are business forecasts and stay out.

**Other years:** The "I think we've achieved AGI" remark on Lex Fridman's podcast (#494) sits on pages dated in 2026, although Benzinga places it in March 2025. The "0% chance AI destroys the world by 2030" interview with CBS and the G20 claim that AGI comes "within two years" also look like 2026.
